messages.author: 6b53adc630dd01e0
messages.subject: MSstats(3.5.1) installation error
parts:
Hi
   I have met a problem when installing MSstats(3.5.1). It still reminds me an unknown error installing packages, although I have reinstalled skyline(64-bit,3.5.1).

   Could someone give me some suggestion? the details is in slides.

Thanks

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: MSstats(3.5.1) installation error
parts:
The error that you are seeing is (in the Immediate Window in Skyline towards the bottom of your screenshot):
InternetOpenUrl failed: 'The operation timed out'

Usually an error like that is temporary and caused by network connectivity problems. It is likely that if you tried this again it would be successful.

If this problem continues to happen for you, it might be helpful if we could see all of the text in the Immediate Window in Skyline.
Can you select all of that text and paste it into this message?

messages.subject: Re: MSstats(3.5.1) installation error
parts:

source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")

Do you have any trouble navigating to the page:
http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R
in your web browser?
